stem.text: A beam of laser light is directed towards a narrow slit.

stem.alt: Square panel containing a short vertical line labelled slit and a grey dot labelled cross-section of beam of light, with a label panel.

stem.text: After emerging from the other side of the slit, the diffracted light then falls on a screen.
What is the pattern of light seen on the screen?

A.alt: Square frame containing a single small grey dot.

B.alt: Square frame containing a horizontal grey bar.

C.alt: Square frame containing a vertical grey bar.

D.alt: Square frame containing a large grey disc.
